args.title: Login, token and profile flow (server.mjs)
args.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  C([Client]) -->|1. POST /api/login| L{username and password match?}
  L -->|no| E1[401 bad credentials]
  L -->|yes, issue token| T[(tokens map: token to username)]
  T -->|2. 200 token and user| C
  C -->|3. GET /api/profile with Bearer token| P{token in tokens map?}
  P -->|no| E2[401 no token]
  P -->|yes| U[Profile from users record]
  U -->|4. 200 username, name, email| C
  C -.->|any other route| N[404 not found]

notes.text: Tokens are `tok-<username>-<Date.now()>` and live only in an in-memory Map, so a restart logs everyone out.
The profile response spreads `password: undefined`, which JSON.stringify drops, so the password is not returned.
Passwords are plain text in the `users` object.
